title: Degree of a two-point indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number with $3\le n$. Consider the function on the Boolean cube over the two-element field that is $1$ at the zero vector and the all-ones vector, and $0$ elsewhere. Its algebraic degree is $n-1$.
